root_causes.confidently_wrong_and_idk: 2.0 keeps knowledge in 10.1M weights and free-writes every reply; retrieval inserts near-miss facts (60% of not-in-base eval questions got one, 58.7% of non-factual dev prompts) and nothing checks the reply against evidence. Measured: 26.7% confidently wrong on not-in-base questions, 5.0% IDK on answerable prompts (2.0 README).
root_causes.size: 72% of the zip is int8 weights stored one value per list item (~1.2 deflated bytes/weight); facts are stored as token-id lists (~3.0 MB per 100K facts) plus a 2.6 MB BM25 index.
root_causes.slow_open_start: 52.6 MB project.json to parse (0.93-1.35 s headless load); green flag allocates KV caches and an 82K-item score list (one 67-74 ms frame).
root_causes.low_fps: each answer's first frame runs retrieval over all 82K facts plus the whole prompt prefill in one warp block (1.0-2.2 s frames), then one ~35 ms forward pass per frame while decoding.
root_causes.kb_small: 82,039 facts, mostly free-text sentences; no structured records, so derived questions cannot be computed.
